subject: Ephemeral evidence window & formal bridge letter request
body:
From: Jordan Willis <auditors@acme-audit.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: mike.hart@acme.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Access request for SOC 2 Type II evidence and bridge letter

Hi Camila,

We're kicking off the final procedures for Acme's FY2026 SOC 2 Type II review and need short-term access to Redwood's trust portal for evidence collection. Two requests:

1) A one-time ephemeral SSO link or timeboxed account for the audit team (read-only preferred; limited download for artifacts we must export).
2) A formal bridge letter confirming the audit period end date and whether any material changes occurred after the period that would affect the report.

Target window: Nov 17–19, 2026 (US PST hours). If that window doesn't work, please propose alternatives. Also let us know about IP allowlist options and whether you can restrict downloads for specific folders.

We need the bridge letter in company letterhead (PDF) and an index of the evidence you'll expose so we can map requests to our workpapers.

Thanks,
Jordan Willis
Senior Manager, Acme Audit
auditors@acme-audit.com

---

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 09:23 AM Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Jordan Willis <auditors@acme-audit.com>
Cc: mike.hart@acme.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access request for SOC 2 Type II evidence and bridge letter

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. We can support a timeboxed reviewer window and generate a bridge letter. Proposed plan:

- Ephemeral access window: 2026-11-17 08:00 PST to 2026-11-19 20:00 PST (audit-only tenant).
- Access type: reviewer role (view + limited download). We can flag folders as view-only; downloads are allowed only where legally required.
- IP allowlist: provide the auditor public IPs and we will add them to the portal allowlist for the window.
- Bridge letter: we will draft a short-form bridge letter confirming the audit period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30) and whether there were material changes relevant to control environment. Draft attached.
- Evidence index: attached spreadsheet shows the folder mapping and suggested file names.

Attachments: bridge-letter-template.pdf (draft), evidence-index-ACME.xlsx

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: confirm retention cutoffs and whether any policy changes occurred in Q3 2026 that need mention in the bridge letter.
- Ben: can you confirm if we can enable view-only for the following S3 buckets and whether download logging will capture auditor exports?

Jordan — if that window works, we'll issue the ephemeral SSO link 24 hours before start and send IP allowlist instructions.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 10:01 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access request for SOC 2 Type II evidence and bridge letter

Camila —

Confirming retention and change notes:
- Retention cutoff for SOC 2 evidence: 2024-10-01 (we keep operational logs for 24 months, config snapshots for 36 months).
- Material changes: Q2 2026 rolling-update for KV cache config (performance tuning) and a bugfix in our deployment orchestration; neither affected control design or control execution for access, change management, or incident response. I'll add a short paragraph to the bridge letter draft that states this.

On the view-only vs download ask: we can make folders view-only via the portal UI and allow auditors to request permitted downloads. Audit export events are logged and exported to the evidence-audit S3 bucket (we'll redact PII if any). Ben, please confirm the export logging retention and whether we can label exports with the HubSpot deal id.

I recommend the following step to reduce risk: provide the auditors with a sandboxed read-only snapshot of key artifacts (config exports, policy PDFs, sample logs) plus a narrow download exception list. That reduces need for wide download permissions.

Marissa
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 11:07 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Access request for SOC 2 Type II evidence and bridge letter

Confirmed:
- Export logging: all portal downloads and S3 exports are logged for 365 days.
- Labeling: we can tag exports with the HubSpot id if provided (please send the id or we will use acme-2026-soc2).
- IP allowlist: add auditors' IP range and we'll apply during the ephemeral window.

I'll prep the sandboxed snapshot and mark the folders read-only except for the specific download exceptions in evidence-index-ACME.xlsx.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 11:07 AM Jordan Willis <auditors@acme-audit.com> wrote:
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: mike.hart@acme.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ephemeral evidence window & formal bridge letter request

Camila —

That plan works for us. Please proceed with the Nov 17–19 window and the draft bridge letter you attached. For the HubSpot id, use: ACME-HP-4872.

A couple of small asks before we begin:
- Can the bridge letter explicitly state the audit period dates and that the report covers controls in operation for that period?
- Please confirm whether the portal session will capture the auditor username in the activity log for traceability.

If you can provide the finalized bridge letter and ephemeral link by EOD Nov 16, we'll finalize travel and logon scheduling.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Manager, Acme Audit

[Attachment stubs referenced above: bridge-letter-template.pdf (1 page, draft), evidence-index-ACME.xlsx (8 sheets)]
